text: Daymare [AS. day + Ger. Mahr , a spectre]: Ger. Oppressionsanfall ; Fr. dépression ( neurasthénique , &c.); Ital. incubo della veglia . A feeling of temporary distress or terror, similar to nightmare, but occurring in a period of wakefulness. It is difficult to assign a cause for the feeling, but it may be connected with a disorder of the cerebral circulation. See NIGHTMARE. ( J.J. )
